summary: Tested new CONVOCAZIONI module (backend + frontend). Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (roster, create draft/sent, list, detail with athletes, patch, contacts, send, delete; coach permission isolation: 403 on non-assigned teams for roster/create/list/get, 200 on own teams). Frontend: Admin end-to-end flow verified — admin/teams → team detail → link-convocations opens /convocations list → 'Nuova convocazione' opens /convocations/editor → fill opponent/date/time → 'Seleziona tutti' selects roster athletes (0/2 → 2/2 on Under 14) → 'Salva' persists DRAFT to backend with 2 athletes correctly stored. Pre-existing draft reopens with pre-filled fields. WhatsApp modal and PDF button added with testIDs. Coach UI link (coach-convocations-btn) is wired to the same /convocations route — tested at code level and via backend permissions (coach can create on assigned team, 403 on others). Note: added 5 testIDs to convocations/index.tsx and convocations/editor.tsx and rebuilt the web bundle (dist) since supervisor serves a pre-built static bundle (not metro dev server).

ui_bugs.issue: On web, after showAlert('Salvata'), router.back() is called synchronously. If the user arrived at the editor via direct deep-link (no history entry), the user stays on the editor instead of returning to the list. In the real admin/coach flow (team → list → editor) it works, but it is fragile. Suggest router.replace(`/convocations?team_id=...`) as a fallback when canGoBack() is false.

No testID on key interactive elements before this run (added by tester): new-convocation-btn, convocation-editor-screen, conv-toggle-all, conv-save-draft-btn, conv-send-wa-btn, conv-pdf-btn, convocations-list-screen. Please keep these.

issues: Delete button is just an inline 'Elimina' Text next to 'Apri'. On a mobile touch target (<44px tall) can be too close to Apri → risk of accidental taps. Consider spacing or a trailing icon-only destructive button.

action_items: (nice-to-have) In convocations/editor.tsx handleSaveDraft: after showAlert, if !router.canGoBack() do router.replace(`/convocations?team_id=${teamId}&team_name=${encodeURIComponent(teamName)}`).
Keep the testIDs added by this tester (new-convocation-btn, conv-save-draft-btn, conv-send-wa-btn, conv-pdf-btn, conv-toggle-all, convocation-editor-screen, convocations-list-screen).
Optional: add testIDs on each athlete checkbox row (e.g. athlete-row-<id>) and on the match calendar rows to make future automation easier.
No functional fix required: backend is 100% and the UI happy-path works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _conv_team_or_403 cleanly handles role-based access (ADMIN/COORDINATORE/DIRIGENTE: all society teams; COACH: only assigned_teams; others 403). Verified end-to-end.
convocations endpoints correctly exclude Mongo _id via _conv_public helper.
list_convocations for coach without team_id filters by assigned_teams — verified.
frontend editor shows preselected gara data when match_id present and loads roster via /api/convocations/team/{id}/roster — OK.
whatsapp modal uses wa.me deep-link (no external integration) — compliant with spec.

After any frontend code change, you MUST run `cd /app/frontend && npx expo export -p web --output-dir dist` then `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_convocations.py. Coach test credentials: alice@test.com / Test1234. On coach dashboard a 'Guida rapida' tutorial overlay blocks clicks — click 'Ho capito' or 'Salta' to dismiss before interacting with team cards.
rca_of_issue: N/A — module works. Only testing-side friction: Playwright click(force=True) on React-Native-Web TouchableOpacity sometimes bypasses the onPress; using plain .click() (without force) correctly fires onPress. Also learned: Playwright page.on('dialog') must be registered BEFORE triggering window.alert so showAlert doesn't block.
